found_by: random-policy LRAT leg on the 07dccc2 debug binary, 2026-08-11 (job 1610524); ~1% of cases, LRAT only. The same defect made tracked corpus entries 005, 006 and 015 fail their LRAT legs.
diagnosis: lrat-check rejected the native LRAT: 'failed while checking clause: -5 0'. The emitted line is `7572 -5 0 0 4058 7568 39 0` -- a LEADING 0 in the hint chain, which the checker's parser reads as the line terminator, so the lemma arrives with an EMPTY hint list. Second member of the corpus-011 family (unit_ids[v] == 0 is LRAT's terminator, so a citation truncates rather than corrupts), but a different reachability. Root cause: propagate_service is the only place root-unit ids are recorded, and it names only the trail suffix its own propagation appended. A SPECULATIVE propagation (kernel_propagate_probing) can also fix a literal at level 0 -- true-level stamping (D-LEVEL-2) assigns a literal at the max level of its reason's other literals, so a clause whose others are all root-false forces at level 0 while the prober stands higher -- and the unwind keeps it, un-named. From a drained root that is impossible; V5 Sweep makes it reachable because it deliberately asserts each environment's units WITHOUT propagating (Kissat parity: the dense pass propagates once, after releasing the sweeper) and then replays the next equivalence through congruence_rup_chain, whose probing propagation drains those pending units at level 0. The consumer is any DIRECT unit_ids citation: here V3 Substitute's large-clause rewrite stripping a root-false literal (var 37, which has no unit line anywhere in the 7574-line proof) and sorting the chain, which moved the 0 to the front. Reason-walk chains are structurally immune, which is why the DRAT legs and every tier run were green. Fixed 2026-08-11: kernel_propagate_probing emits the LRAT unit line for every root literal it derived (kernel_emit_root_units, lifted out of propagate.cpp into the kernel), so 'root-fixed implies it has a unit id' is a kernel invariant rather than one rule's obligation; kernel_check_invariants asserts it at each rule boundary, and Proof::add_rup/add_rat reject a zero antecedent so a hand-built chain aborts at its emitter instead of at the checker. Proof-only: DRAT output and the search trajectory are unchanged. THIS CASE: 07dccc2 answers UNSAT and lrat-check rejects; the fixed binary answers UNSAT and lrat-check verifies.
